name: email-template-builder
description: Turn an email screenshot or design into a responsive HTML email: the agent writes MJML, the plugin compiles it to email-client-safe HTML (table layout, inline styles), lists the {{variables}} with editable sample data, previews desktop / mobile / dark mode next to the design, and checks width, alt text, image URLs, links, colour contrast, preheader, dark-mode styles, unsubscribe link and size (Gmail clips over 102 KB). Exports HTML + plain text. Nothing is sent.

Exports HTML + plain text. Nothing is sent.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把邮件截图或设计稿做成响应式 HTML 邮件：Agent 写 MJML，插件编译成主流邮箱兼容的 HTML（表格布局、内联样式），列出 {{变量}} 并可编辑样例数据，与设计稿并排预览桌面 / 手机 / 深色模式，检查宽度、图片替代文字、图片地址、链接、文字对比度、预览行、深色模式样式、退订链接和体积（Gmail 超过 102 KB 会截断）。导出 HTML 和纯文本版。不发送邮件。
